item.title: 曝苹果新 CEO Ternus 希望更快发产品、精简组织
item.guid: 曝苹果新-CEO-Ternus-希望更快发产品、精简组织
item.description:
According to Bloomberg, Apple's new CEO John Ternus is planning to adjust the company's organization and product release rhythm, hoping to make Apple more streamlined and decision-making faster, in response to the competition in the AI era. 据彭博社报道，苹果新任 CEO John Ternus 正筹划调整公司组织与产品发布节奏，希望让苹果更精简、决策更快，以应对人工智能时代的竞争。

Ternus believes that Apple needs to launch products faster and increase experimentation; he is also evaluating reducing reliance on traditional spring and autumn release cycles, opting instead for more frequent product releases throughout the year. Ternus 认为，苹果需要更快推出产品、增加试验性；他也在评估减少对春季和秋季传统发布周期的依赖，改为全年更频繁地发布产品。

Apple plans to launch multiple devices next year, including AirPods with cameras, its first smart glasses, and a redesigned model prepared for the iPhone's 20th anniversary. The report states that Ternus is reconsidering new product release arrangements, but changing Apple's long-established development process could take several years. 苹果明年计划推出多款设备，包括带摄像头的 AirPods、首款智能眼镜，以及为 iPhone 诞生 20 周年准备的重新设计机型。报道称，Ternus 正重新考虑新品发布安排，但改变苹果长期形成的开发流程可能需要数年。

Organizational adjustments have also begun. Apple's hardware engineering department has laid off several engineering project managers in the past two weeks, including about 6 high-level executives; employees who cannot find other positions within the company may be dismissed later. 组织调整也已开始。苹果硬件工程部门近两周裁撤了多名工程项目经理，其中包括约 6 名高级别主管；未能在公司内部找到其他岗位的员工，之后可能被解雇。

Apple has also recently conducted layoffs in teams such as Siri, Vision Pro, and AI-related software engineering, and has scaled back or canceled some early projects. 苹果近期还在 Siri、Vision Pro 和 AI 相关软件工程等团队进行裁员，并缩减或取消部分早期项目。

Meanwhile, Ternus, along with Eddy Cue, head of services, and Kevan Parekh, head of finance, are discussing new services and ways to increase revenue from existing products and services. The slowdown in Apple's services business growth and rising memory costs are also putting pressure on the company. The report notes that Apple is also controlling costs, but has not yet announced a specific timeline for broader adjustments. 与此同时，Ternus 与服务业务负责人 Eddy Cue、财务负责人 Kevan Parekh 正讨论新的服务，以及从现有产品和服务中增加收入的方式。苹果服务业务增长放缓、内存成本上升，也给公司带来压力。报道指出，苹果还在控制成本，但尚未公布更广泛调整的具体时间表。

item.title: 华为 Mate 90 真机进店，拼色机身与十倍变焦模块先亮相
item.guid: 华为-Mate-90-真机进店，拼色机身与十倍变焦模块先亮相
item.description:
The Huawei Mate 90 series was displayed in some offline stores on September 29. The new phone adopts a two-tone color scheme, with green, black, gray, white, orange, and other versions visible on site; the Mate 90 RS Ultimate Design was also showcased. Huawei plans to officially launch the series at 10:00 on October 1, with sales starting at 12:08 on the same day. 华为 Mate 90 系列 9 月 29 日已在部分线下门店展示。新机采用双拼配色，现场可见绿色、黑色、灰色、白色、橙色等版本；Mate 90 RS 非凡大师也已展示。华为计划在 10 月 1 日 10:00 正式发布该系列，并于当日 12:08 开售。

The store also displayed the Ruijing Z10 zoom module. It features a built-in 1-inch sensor, offering 10x optical zoom, and is an external camera module with independent imaging hardware, rather than just a teleconverter that adds a magnifying lens in front of the phone's lens. It needs to be used with specified models such as the Mate 90 Pro Max Collector's Edition and Mate 90 RS Ultimate Design, and the module and grip need to be purchased separately. Real photos of the phone and accessories have been unblocked in stores, and the press conference will still announce the full configuration and sales arrangements. 门店同时展示了睿影 Z10 变焦模块。它内置 1 英寸传感器，提供 10 倍光学变焦，属于带独立成像硬件的外置相机模块，而非只在手机镜头前增加放大镜片的增距镜。它需与 Mate 90 Pro Max 典藏版、Mate 90 RS 非凡大师等指定型号配合使用，模块和手柄需要单独购买。门店真机与配件实拍已解禁，发布会仍将公布完整配置与销售安排。

item.title: OpenAI DevDay 2026 发布 20 多项更新：常驻智能体 dots、GPT‑6.1 Sol 同台亮相
item.guid: OpenAI-DevDay-2026-发布-20-多项更新：常驻智能体-dots、GPT‑6.1-Sol-同台亮相
item.description:
OpenAI held DevDay 2026 in San Francisco, announcing over 20 updates at once, covering ChatGPT, Codex, models, and APIs. The official statement called it the largest DevDay to date and mentioned that ChatGPT collectively has 1.2 billion users. OpenAI 在旧金山举行 DevDay 2026，一次性公布 20 多项更新，涵盖 ChatGPT、Codex、模型与 API。官方称这是迄今规模最大的一届 DevDay，并提到 ChatGPT 合计拥有 12 亿用户。

    dots, AI agents that can run 24/7 and continuously perform duties, powered by GPT‑6 Astra, each with their own cloud computer, capable of working within applications connected by users.

    GPT‑6.1 Sol, officially described as a major upgrade to GPT‑6 Sol, enhances agent programming, computer usage, and professional work capabilities. Its intelligence level is close to Astra, and the standard input and output Token price is only one-fifth of Astra's.

The standard API price for GPT-6.1-Sol is $2 per million Tokens for input, $0.1 for cached input, and $10 for output. GPT-6.1-Sol 的 API 标准价格为每百万 Token 输入 2 美元、缓存输入 0.1 美元、输出 10 美元。

The "ultra-high speed" tier launched simultaneously can increase Token generation speed in Codex by up to 8 times (300 Tokens per second), and up to 6 times in the API. GPT‑6 Astra ultra-high speed is already live, and GPT‑6.1 Sol ultra-high speed is coming soon. 同时推出的「超高速」档位可将 Codex 中的 Token 生成速度最高提升 8 倍（每秒 300 个 Token），API 中最高提升 6 倍。GPT‑6 Astra 超高速已上线，GPT‑6.1 Sol 超高速即将推出。

In terms of developer tools, Codex Cloud supports running tasks remotely on computers, phones, or in the cloud; Codex CLI adds voice conversation and /agents view; the ChatGPT desktop application includes code review functionality supporting GitHub Pull Requests and GitLab Merge Requests; Codex Security Cloud can continuously check new commits, or scan entire GitHub code repositories on demand or at scheduled times. 开发者工具方面，Codex Cloud 支持在电脑、手机远程或云端运行任务；Codex CLI 新增语音对话和 /agents 视图；ChatGPT 桌面应用加入支持 GitHub Pull Request 和 GitLab 合并请求的代码审查功能；Codex Security Cloud 可持续检查新提交，或按需、定时扫描整个 GitHub 代码仓库。

🔗 Related reading: Just now, ChatGPT copied half of the AI circle overnight, with frequent demo failures 🔗 相关阅读： 刚刚，ChatGPT 一夜抄完半个 AI 圈，现场演示频频翻车

item.title: DeepSeek Harness 推出桌面端预览版
item.guid: DeepSeek-Harness-推出桌面端预览版
item.description:
The DeepSeek Harness team released v0.2 preview on September 29, offering macOS and Windows desktop installers for the first time. The plugin-based Agent tool, originally for developers, now includes an installation wizard, allowing users to process documents, spreadsheets, PDFs, and code tasks on the desktop, and view generated files and code changes. DeepSeek Harness 团队 9 月 29 日发布 v0.2 预览版，首次提供 macOS 和 Windows 桌面安装包。原本面向开发者的插件式 Agent 工具由此增加了安装向导，用户可以在桌面端处理文档、表格、PDF 和代码任务，并查看生成文件及代码改动。

The new version adds a plugin management page, allowing installation by entering an npm package name, and enabling deactivation or uninstallation of plugins from the same interface; automation task plugins can be enabled on demand to set scheduled executions and view run records. The team states that sandbox security, agent teams, long-term memory, browser, and GUI automation are still in the roadmap, and the current version is still in preview. Desktop downloads are now available on the official website. 新版本加入插件管理页面，输入 npm 包名即可安装，也能在同一界面停用或卸载插件；自动化任务插件可按需开启，用来设置定时执行和查看运行记录。团队称，沙箱安全、智能体团队、长期记忆、浏览器及 GUI 自动化仍在后续路线中，当前版本还处于预览阶段。官网现已开放桌面端下载。

🔗 Related reading: DeepSeek Harness Desktop Version Hands-on: More like a "personal assistant," and it even gives you money 🔗 相关阅读： DeepSeek Harness桌面版实测：更像「个人助理」，还给你送钱

item.title: 特斯拉 Roadster 发布会因天气推迟至 10 月 15 日，活动只能在户外举行
item.guid: 特斯拉-Roadster-发布会因天气推迟至-10-月-15-日，活动只能在户外举行
item.description:
Tesla announced in the early hours of September 29 that the second-generation Roadster launch event, originally scheduled for October 1, has been postponed to October 15. The company stated that it has been continuously monitoring the weather with local meteorological experts, and forecasts indicate that severe weather may occur on the day of the event, and this launch event "can only be held outdoors." New event details will be announced later. 特斯拉 9 月 29 日凌晨宣布，原定 10 月 1 日举行的第二代 Roadster 发布会改至 10 月 15 日。公司称已与当地气象专家持续跟踪天气，预报显示活动当天可能出现恶劣天气，而这场发布会「只能在户外举行」。新的活动细节将在稍后公布。

The phrase "can only be held outdoors" has also made this rescheduling particularly noteworthy. Tesla previously teased the event with images of a sports car with a contrail; Musk had discussed equipping the Roadster with SpaceX cold gas thrusters and stated that a live demonstration would require audience testimony. Currently, these statements are still teasers and conjectures, and Tesla has not confirmed that the production car can fly. The second-generation Roadster concept car first debuted in 2017, and its release date has been adjusted multiple times since then. 「只能在户外举行」也让这次改期格外受关注。特斯拉此前用带有尾流的跑车画面预热活动；马斯克曾谈及让 Roadster 采用 SpaceX 冷气推进器，并称现场展示需要观众作证。目前这些表述仍属于预告与设想，特斯拉没有确认量产车能飞行。第二代 Roadster 概念车最早在 2017 年亮相，此后发布时间多次调整。

item.title: 携程鼓励员工休「无理由事假」：每休 1 天，团队获 600 元奖励
item.guid: 携程鼓励员工休「无理由事假」：每休-1-天，团队获-600-元奖励
item.description:
According to Jiemian News, Trip.com recently notified employees that starting last week, for every day an employee takes 'unjustified personal leave,' their team will receive a 600 yuan reward for team building and other activities. The reward is given to the team, not the employee taking leave, addressing concerns that employees might worry about burdening their team or inconveniencing their supervisor by taking time off. 据界面新闻报道，携程近日通知员工，自上周起，每有员工休 1 天「无理由事假」，其所在团队可获得 600 元奖励，用于团建等场景。奖励给团队而非请假员工，针对的是员工担心请假拖累团队、给主管添麻烦的顾虑。

This incentive follows Trip.com's vacation experiment launched this year. The company previously announced that starting May 1st, a one-year randomized controlled trial would be conducted in some business departments, with approximately 6,000 employees divided into experimental and control groups. In addition to their existing paid leave, the experimental group can take up to 45 days of unjustified personal leave annually, without needing to state a reason; salary and attendance during leave will still follow current personal leave rules. 这项激励接在携程今年启动的休假实验之后。公司此前宣布，从 5 月 1 日起，在部分业务部门开展为期 1 年的随机对照实验，约 6000 名员工分入实验组和对照组。实验组在原有带薪假期之外，每年最多可休 45 天无理由事假，无需说明事由；请假期间的薪酬与考勤仍按现行事假规则执行。

item.title: OpenAI 将恢复 200 美元 Pro 订阅，但用量减半
item.guid: OpenAI-将恢复-200-美元-Pro-订阅，但用量减半
item.description:
Tibo Sottiaux, OpenAI's product lead for Codex and ChatGPT, stated on September 29th that the $200/month Pro subscription would reopen to new users the next day, along with a change in usage calculation. Based on API list prices, the new plan offers about half the usage of the old version; this is an equivalent consumption metric and does not mean that the actual task count for all models will be neatly halved. OpenAI 的 Codex 与 ChatGPT 产品负责人 Tibo Sottiaux 9 月 29 日表示，月费 200 美元的 Pro 订阅将于次日重新向新用户开放，同时改变用量计算方式。按 API 标价折算，新方案提供的用量约为旧版的一半；这是等值消费口径，不代表所有模型的实际任务次数都会整齐减半。

Sottiaux explained that OpenAI has already halved the API prices for GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna this week, and improved model efficiency and price reductions might allow users to accomplish more work with fewer API equivalent credits. The company promised not to reinstate the Pro's 5-hour usage limit and previewed new content that won't consume plan usage, with details yet to be announced. OpenAI has not yet provided actual completion data for various tasks after the adjustment. Sottiaux 解释，OpenAI 本周已将 GPT-6 Sol 和 GPT-6 Luna 的 API 价格降至此前约一半，模型效率和降价可能让用户用更少的 API 等值额度完成更多工作。公司承诺不会恢复 Pro 的 5 小时用量限制，并预告将加入不消耗套餐用量的新内容，细节尚待公布。OpenAI 尚未给出调整后各类任务的实际完成量数据。

item.title: 比亚迪西咸电池基地全面投产，为第二代刀片电池首批生产基地
item.guid: 比亚迪西咸电池基地全面投产，为第二代刀片电池首批生产基地
item.description:
According to a September 29th announcement from Xi'an Release, BYD's new energy vehicle power battery project in Qinhan New City, Xixian New Area, has been fully completed and put into production. The base includes cell and battery pack production lines, providing localized battery support for BYD's vehicle manufacturing in Xi'an. 据西安发布 9 月 29 日消息，比亚迪位于西咸新区秦汉新城的新能源汽车动力电池项目已全面建成投产。基地包含电芯和电池包生产线，为比亚迪在西安的整车制造提供本地化电池配套。

The project's first cell production line rolled off in October last year; in March this year, after BYD released its second-generation Blade Battery and flash charging technology, the Xixian base became one of the first production bases and started trial production. The new point in this announcement is the full commissioning of the entire project, rather than the initial release of battery technology. The base covers stages such as electrode preparation, cell forming, module assembly, battery pack integration, and system testing. 项目的首条电芯产线在去年 10 月下线；今年 3 月，比亚迪发布第二代刀片电池与闪充技术后，西咸基地进入首批生产基地并启动试生产。此次消息的新增点是整个项目全面投产，而非电池技术首次发布。基地覆盖电极制备、电芯成型、模组组装、电池包集成与系统测试等环节。

item.title: 中国生成式 AI 用户突破 7 亿，智能问答仍是最常见用途
item.guid: 中国生成式-AI-用户突破-7-亿，智能问答仍是最常见用途
item.description:
The 'Generative AI Application Development Report (2026)' released by the China Internet Network Information Center on September 29th shows that as of the first half of this year, the scale of generative AI users in China has exceeded 700 million, with a penetration rate of over 50%. The report, announced at the China Internet Basic Resources Conference, defines its statistical scope as users who use generative AI, which is not equivalent to active users of a single application. 中国互联网络信息中心 9 月 29 日发布的《生成式人工智能应用发展报告（2026）》显示，截至今年上半年，我国生成式 AI 用户规模突破 7 亿，普及率超过 50%。报告在中国互联网基础资源大会公布，统计范围是使用生成式 AI 的用户，不等同于单一应用的活跃用户。

Among surveyed users, 76.0% use generative AI to answer questions; the proportions for processing images or videos, processing text, and creating work summaries, meeting minutes, and PPTs are 47.8%, 37.6%, and 32.5% respectively. The report also states that the usage frequency of AI comprehensive assistants and AI efficiency office applications both increased by over 100% year-on-year. These data illustrate the usage structure of generative AI expanding from Q&A to content processing and office tasks. 在受访用户中，76.0% 会用生成式 AI 回答问题；处理图片或视频、处理文本、制作工作总结或会议纪要及 PPT 的比例分别为 47.8%、37.6% 和 32.5%。报告还称，AI 综合助手与 AI 效率办公应用的使用次数同比均增长超过 100%。这些数据呈现了生成式 AI 从问答向内容处理和办公任务扩展的使用结构。

item.title: 比亚迪王朝网第 1000 万辆汽车下线，下线车型为大汉
item.guid: 比亚迪王朝网第-1000-万辆汽车下线，下线车型为大汉
item.description:
Lu Tian, General Manager of BYD Dynasty Network Sales Division, announced on September 29th that the 10 millionth vehicle of the Dynasty Network has rolled off the production line. The model is the upcoming flagship sedan, the 'Dahan'. The 10 million units here refer to the cumulative scale of the Dynasty Network, not the total production of BYD Group's new energy vehicles. 比亚迪王朝网销售事业部总经理路天 9 月 29 日宣布，王朝网第 1000 万辆汽车下线，下线车型为即将上市的旗舰轿车大汉。这里的千万台指王朝网累计规模，并非比亚迪集团新能源汽车总产量。

The Dahan is the Dynasty Network's first D-segment flagship sedan, with pre-sales already launched at the Chengdu Auto Show and an official market launch planned for October 13th. Previously disclosed, the pure electric rear-wheel drive version has a maximum CLTC range of 1008 kilometers, a length of 5256mm, and a wheelbase of 3130mm. This production line announcement does not alter the previously announced launch schedule. 大汉是王朝网首款 D 级旗舰轿车，已在成都车展开启预售，计划于 10 月 13 日正式上市。此前公开的纯电后驱版最高 CLTC 续航为 1008 公里，车长 5256mm、轴距 3130mm。此次下线消息没有改变已公布的上市节奏。

item.title: 曝豆包筹划独立个人助理，内部项目 Spell 已于 4 月测试
item.guid: 曝豆包筹划独立个人助理，内部项目-Spell-已于-4-月测试
item.description: According to Sina Tech, ByteDance's Doubao is planning a personal assistant product. An insider stated that the Doubao Mobile Assistant team began internal testing an exploratory project codenamed 'Spell' in April this year, planning to integrate its capabilities more deeply with Doubao products; the new product will be jointly responsible by the Spell project and the Doubao dialogue team. 据新浪科技报道，字节跳动豆包正在规划个人助理产品。一位知情人士称，豆包手机助手团队今年 4 月已开始内测代号「Spell」的探索项目，计划将其能力与豆包产品更深入结合；新产品将由 Spell 项目与豆包对话团队共同负责。

item.title: 💡 Instinct 创始人：AI 助手影响用户购买不想要的商品，将是「非常危险的世界」
item.guid: 💡-Instinct-创始人：AI-助手影响用户购买不想要的商品，将是「非常危险的世界」
item.description:
According to Business Insider, Noah Shinn, founder of AI assistant Instinct, stated that it would be 'a very dangerous world' if AI agents use their capabilities to influence users to buy goods or services they don't want. 据《商业内幕》报道，AI 助手 Instinct 创始人 Noah Shinn 表示，如果 AI 智能体利用自身能力影响用户购买他们并不想要的商品或服务，将会是「非常危险的世界」。

He stated that Instinct does not want to influence user behavior through commercialization, causing them to deviate from their own desires. 他称，Instinct 不希望通过商业化影响用户行为，使其偏离自身意愿。

If Instinct influences users to buy things they don't want to buy, or subscribe to services they don't want to subscribe to, and uses its intelligence to persuade them, that would be a very dangerous world.

Shinn mentioned on the podcast 'Invest Like The Best' that Instinct's data shows that within the first three weeks of use, 40% of users have shared credit card information; for users who share sensitive information like credit cards, the retention rate reaches 80%. Shinn 在播客节目《Invest Like The Best》中谈到，Instinct 的数据表明，用户使用前三周内，有 40% 的人分享过信用卡信息；分享信用卡等敏感信息的用户，留存率达到 80%。

He believes that users need several weeks to build trust, and providing more information also allows the assistant to be more proactive, understand the user's situation better, and offer more targeted help. 他认为，用户需要数周时间建立信任，而提供更多信息也能让助手更主动、更了解用户处境，并提供更有针对性的帮助。

This trust also involves how Instinct will commercialize. Shinn criticized that some free platforms push paid advertisements to users, trying to persuade them to buy products they might not need. 这份信任也涉及 Instinct 将如何实现商业化。Shinn 批评，一些免费平台会向用户推送付费广告，试图说服他们购买可能并不需要的商品。

He stated that Instinct does not want users to become the product, nor does it want the assistant to convert user trust into the ability to persuade consumption. 他表示，Instinct 不希望用户成为产品，也不希望助手将用户信任转化为说服消费的能力。

item.title: 5999 元起，iQOO 16 发布
item.guid: 5999-元起，iQOO-16-发布
item.description:
iQOO released the iQOO 16 phone, the iQOO Pad Ultra small-sized tablet, and a cross-device gaming headset on September 29th. The three new products are aimed at mobile gaming, high-load tablet gaming, and multi-device audio use, respectively; the phone and headset are already on sale, and the tablet's initial sale discount continues until October 5th. iQOO 9 月 29 日发布 iQOO 16 手机、iQOO Pad Ultra 小尺寸平板和一款跨端头戴电竞耳机。三款新品分别面向手机游戏、高负载平板游戏和多设备音频使用；其中手机及耳机已开售，平板首销优惠持续至 10 月 5 日。

    The iQOO 16 is among the first to feature the 6th Gen Snapdragon 8 Super Extreme Edition, equipped with a 2K, 165Hz Samsung Everest screen and a self-developed gaming chip Q4. The device boasts an 8400mAh battery, 100W wired fast charging, and a 50-megapixel 1/1.3-inch main camera. The 12GB + 256GB version retails for 5999 yuan, with a final price of 5499 yuan after national subsidies.

    The iQOO Pad Ultra features an 8.8-inch, 165Hz OLED screen, is equipped with the same Qualcomm chip, a self-developed Q4 chip, and a built-in fan, and comes with a 9020mAh battery and 66W charging. The device is 5.74mm thick and weighs approximately 298g, with the 12GB + 256GB version priced at 6499 yuan.

    The iQOO over-ear gaming headset supports four-mode connection between mobile phones, tablets, PCs, and game consoles, and features a detachable microphone, cross-device spatial audio, and active noise cancellation. The retail price is 699 yuan, with a 50 yuan discount when purchased with an iQOO 16.

item.title: 腾讯邀请制内测「鹅次元」，AI 伙伴能看游戏画面并语音陪玩
item.guid: 腾讯邀请制内测「鹅次元」，AI-伙伴能看游戏画面并语音陪玩
item.description:
Tencent is internally testing its game companion product "E-Dimension" by invitation. According to "Product Notes" actual tests, after users enter an invitation code on the PC client, they can choose to text chat or voice call with AI characters, and can also set characters as desktop pets and wallpapers; currently, three of the four displayed characters are available for use. 腾讯正在邀请制内测游戏陪伴产品「鹅次元」。据「产品笔记」实测，用户在电脑客户端输入邀请码后，可以选择 AI 角色文字聊天或语音通话，也能将角色设为桌面宠物和壁纸；目前展示的四个角色中，有三个可以使用。

After enabling screen sharing, the AI companion can read game screens and converse based on the match situation. The beta version lists compatible games including "Valorant," CS2, and "League of Legends." The product interface states that the experience does not consume energy during the confidential internal test, and energy exchange and consumption rules are still displayed on the interface; the official launch time and charging methods have not yet been announced. 开启屏幕共享后，AI 伙伴可读取游戏画面，并根据对局情况对话。内测版列出的适配游戏包括《无畏契约》、CS2 和《英雄联盟》。产品界面称保密内测期间体验不消耗能量，能量兑换和消耗规则仍显示在界面中；正式开放时间和收费方式尚未公布。

item.title: 苏黎世联邦理工学院展示五指行走的机器人手，还能按键与推物
item.guid: 苏黎世联邦理工学院展示五指行走的机器人手，还能按键与推物
item.description:
The Soft Robotics Lab at ETH Zurich has demonstrated a robotic hand capable of supporting itself with five fingers and crawling on the ground. The research team equipped it with an onboard power supply and computing unit, and trained control strategies for different tasks using reinforcement learning in a hardware-calibrated simulated environment. 苏黎世联邦理工学院软体机器人实验室展示了一只能够用五根手指支撑自身、在地面爬行的机器人手。研究团队给它配上机载电源与计算单元，并在经过硬件校准的模拟环境中，用强化学习训练不同任务的控制策略。

Experimental videos show it autonomously crawling, turning, and getting up after falling on indoor and outdoor surfaces. The research paper records that the robotic hand can press keys while maintaining a supporting posture, completing 29 correct key presses out of 32 continuous keyboard commands; when pushing objects, it needs the assistance of an overhead camera for positioning. Crawling, pressing keys, and pushing objects use their respective strategies, and it is currently a laboratory prototype, not a commercial robot with general manipulation capabilities. 实验视频展示了它在室内外地面自主爬行、转向和跌倒后起身。研究论文记录，机器人手可以一边保持支撑姿态一边按键，连续 32 次键盘指令中完成 29 次正确按键；推动物体时则需要借助上方摄像头定位。爬行、按键和推物使用各自的策略，目前属于实验室原型，不是已经具备通用操作能力的商用机器人。

item.title: 领克 20 上市限时 11.88 万元起，续航与补能升级、零百加速放缓
item.guid: 领克-20-上市限时-11.88-万元起，续航与补能升级、零百加速放缓
item.description:
The Lynk & Co 20 was launched on the evening of September 28th, with an official limited-time exclusive price starting from 118,800 yuan. In an analysis the following day, Aifaner's Dongchehui pointed out that when this car replaced the Z20, it shifted its focus from 0-100 km/h acceleration to range, energy replenishment, and assisted driving: the platform was upgraded from 400V to 800V, the maximum CLTC range increased from 530 km to 630 km, and a 6C charging solution was adopted. 领克 20 于 9 月 28 日晚上市，官方给出的限时专享价为 11.88 万元起。爱范儿董车会在次日分析中指出，这款车接替 Z20 时，把重点从零百加速转向续航、补能与辅助驾驶：平台由 400V 升至 800V，最长 CLTC 续航由 530 公里提高至 630 公里，并采用 6C 补能方案。

There are also trade-offs in power parameters. The report compares that the maximum motor power was adjusted from 250kW to 245kW, and the 0-100 km/h acceleration changed from 5.3 seconds to 6.4 seconds; the Lynk & Co 20 series is fully equipped with lidar and the Qianli Haohan H5 assisted driving system. Dongchehui therefore believes that Lynk & Co is addressing the Z20's shortcomings in daily energy replenishment and intelligence while reducing some performance indicators. The Lynk & Co official website has launched the model page and configuration table. 动力参数也有取舍。报道对比称，最大电机功率由 250kW 调整为 245kW，零百加速由 5.3 秒变为 6.4 秒；领克 20 全系配备激光雷达和千里浩瀚 H5 辅助驾驶系统。董车会据此认为，领克是在降低部分性能指标的同时补齐 Z20 在日常补能和智能化上的短板。领克官网已上线车型页与配置表。

item.title: 星巴克首次进入新疆，乌鲁木齐大巴扎与机场双店开业
item.guid: 星巴克首次进入新疆，乌鲁木齐大巴扎与机场双店开业
item.description:
Starbucks China announced its entry into the Xinjiang market on September 29th, with the Urumqi International Grand Bazaar Intangible Cultural Heritage Flagship Store and Tianshan International Airport Store opening on the same day. The Grand Bazaar store, dubbed "Starbazaar," is its first national intangible cultural heritage flagship store; the airport store, named "Silk Road Post," caters to travelers. 星巴克中国 9 月 29 日宣布进入新疆市场，乌鲁木齐国际大巴扎非遗旗舰店与天山国际机场店同日开业。大巴扎店被称为「星巴扎」，是其全国首家非遗旗舰店；机场店则面向旅客，命名为「丝路驿站」。

The Grand Bazaar store's architecture is designed with the silhouette of a bazaar canopy, incorporating elements such as Atlas silk and ethnic musical instruments into the space, and collaborating with inheritors of Xinjiang's Twelve Muqams intangible cultural heritage to offer song and dance experiences. Starbucks also launched local-flavored drinks, food, and city gifts at both stores, featuring ingredients like pomegranate, baklava, and milk skin. 大巴扎店以巴扎棚顶轮廓设计建筑，将艾德莱斯绸、民族乐器等元素融入空间，并与新疆十二木卡姆非遗传承者合作推出歌舞体验。星巴克还在两家店推出融合红石榴、巴克拉瓦和奶皮子等地方风味的饮品、美食与城市礼品。

During the National Day holiday, one Xinjiang specialty drink and three food items will be temporarily available in over 2,700 Starbucks stores across 41 cities nationwide. Starbucks had previously opened 7 intangible cultural heritage concept stores across the country, and this time it further categorized intangible cultural heritage stores into two types: flagship stores and cultural tourism stores. 国庆期间，其中 1 款新疆特色饮品和 3 款美食将限时进入全国 41 个城市的 2700 余家星巴克门店。此前星巴克已在全国开设 7 家非遗概念店，此次将非遗门店进一步分为旗舰店与文旅店两种类型。

item.title: 瑞幸新加坡第 100 家门店开业，全球门店超过 3.8 万家
item.guid: 瑞幸新加坡第-100-家门店开业，全球门店超过-3.8-万家
item.description:
Luckin Coffee announced on September 28th that its 100th store in Singapore opened in Bugis. This marks the first time Luckin's local store count has reached 100 since it began overseas operations in Singapore in 2023. The company states that it has cumulatively served over 1.9 million transacting customers in Singapore and has become the second-largest coffee chain brand in the local market by store count. 瑞幸咖啡 9 月 28 日宣布，新加坡第 100 家门店在武吉士开业。这是瑞幸 2023 年从新加坡开始海外经营以来，当地门店规模首次达到百店。公司称，目前在新加坡已累计服务超过 190 万名交易客户，按门店数量计算，已成为当地第二大的连锁咖啡品牌。

This new store is located in Bugis Junction. Luckin has successively launched products in Singapore that combine local flavors, such as Pandan, Brown Sugar, and Milo; the company stated at an event that the sales of Coconut Latte and Little Yellow Butter Latte have both exceeded 2 million cups locally. Its global store count has exceeded 38,000, covering China, Singapore, Malaysia, and the United States. The 100-store milestone indicates Luckin's continued expansion in Singapore, but overseas stores currently still represent only a small portion of its global network. 这家新店位于白沙浮广场。瑞幸在新加坡陆续推出斑斓、黑糖、美禄等结合当地口味的产品；公司在活动上称，生椰拿铁与小黄油拿铁在当地的销量均超过 200 万杯。其全球门店数已超过 3.8 万家，覆盖中国、新加坡、马来西亚和美国。百店里程碑说明瑞幸在新加坡持续扩张，但海外门店目前仍只占全球网络的一小部分。

item.title: 《沙丘 3》确认引进中国内地，档期尚未公布
item.guid: 《沙丘-3》确认引进中国内地，档期尚未公布
item.description:
News broke on September 29th that the third film in the "Dune" series, "Dune 3," has been confirmed for release in mainland Chinese cinemas, though the mainland release date has not yet been announced. The film is directed by Denis Villeneuve and is the final chapter of his "Dune" trilogy; it is scheduled to be released in North America on December 18th, and the official movie website states that it will be distributed by Legendary East in China. 《沙丘》系列电影第三部《沙丘 3》9 月 29 日传出确认引进中国内地院线的消息，内地上映日期尚未公布。影片由丹尼斯·维伦纽瓦执导，是其《沙丘》三部曲的最终章；北美计划于 12 月 18 日上映，官方电影网站列明中国地区由传奇东方发行。

The new film continues the story of Paul Atreides, adapted from Frank Herbert's "Dune Messiah." Actors such as Timothée Chalamet and Zendaya return, and the official trailer was previously released. The mainland Chinese release date and whether it will be released simultaneously with overseas markets are still awaiting official announcement from the filmmakers. 新片延续保罗·厄崔迪的故事，改编自弗兰克·赫伯特的《沙丘救世主》。提莫西·查拉梅与赞达亚等演员回归，官方此前已发布预告。中国内地上映日期及是否与海外同步上映，仍待片方公布。

item.title: 东京电影节公布黑泽明奖得主：O Mipo 与 Mohammad Rasoulof 获奖
item.guid: 东京电影节公布黑泽明奖得主：O-Mipo-与-Mohammad-Rasoulof-获奖
item.description:
The 39th Tokyo International Film Festival announced this year's Akira Kurosawa Award recipients on September 29th: Japanese director O Mipo and Iranian director Mohammad Rasoulof. Members of the selection committee included Yoji Yamada, Lee Sang-il, and festival program director Shozo Ichiyama, among others. 第 39 届东京国际电影节 9 月 29 日公布今年的黑泽明奖得主，分别为日本导演 O Mipo 与伊朗导演 Mohammad Rasoulof。评选委员会成员包括山田洋次、李相日和电影节节目总监市山尚三等人。

O Mipo previously won the Best Director Award at the Montreal World Film Festival for "The Light Shines Only There" and has continued to direct feature films in recent years. Rasoulof's "There Is No Evil" won the Golden Bear at the Berlin Film Festival, and "The Seed of the Sacred Fig" received the Jury Special Prize at the Cannes Film Festival and was shortlisted for the Academy Award for Best International Feature Film. The festival states that the Akira Kurosawa Award honors directors who continue to create and have an influential impact on the future of cinema. O Mipo 曾凭《只在那里发光》获得蒙特利尔世界电影节最佳导演奖，近年仍持续拍摄剧情长片。Rasoulof 的《无邪》曾获柏林电影节金熊奖，《神圣无花果之种》获戛纳电影节评审团特别奖，并入围奥斯卡最佳国际影片奖。电影节称，黑泽明奖表彰持续创作、对未来电影有影响力的导演。
